title: Syril Karn
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: Ambitious inspector Syril Karn ignored the instructions of his superior officer regarding the investigation of the killings of two Pre-Mor security officers. Karn, fixating on discovering the truth behind the officer's deaths, and by way of a convenient lead, quickly uncovered a likely suspect: Cassian Andor. Through Syril's bold and insubordinate actions, he initially found himself demoted and crushed until he met Dedra Meero and began a new ascent through the Empire.
